config.label: Permission profile: readonly (observation only), standard (adds desktop interaction and file access), or full (adds process control and shell execution)
config.description: Permission profile: readonly (observation only), standard (adds desktop interaction and file access), or full (adds process control and shell execution). Defaults to standard.

config.label: Comma-separated capability tiers, overriding the profile
config.description: Comma-separated capability tiers, overriding the profile. Any of: observe, interact, filesystem, manage, shell.

config.label: Semicolon-separated folders that file tools may access
config.description: Semicolon-separated folders that file tools may access. Empty means the whole filesystem except protected Windows system directories.

config.label: Set to false to skip user confirmation prompts for destructive actions
config.description: Set to false to skip user confirmation prompts for destructive actions. Defaults to true.

config.label: Path to the JSONL audit log
config.description: Path to the JSONL audit log. Defaults to %LOCALAPPDATA%\winctl\audit.jsonl.

config.label: Screenshots are downscaled to at most this width in pixels
config.description: Screenshots are downscaled to at most this width in pixels. Defaults to 1600.
